abstract_sentences.text: Evaluating tabular generators remains a challenging problem, as the unique causal structural prior of heterogeneous tabular data does not lend itself to intuitive human inspection.

evidence.anchor: Evaluating tabular generators remains a challenging problem

abstract_sentences.handoff: introduces the evaluation object and why structure is hard to inspect

abstract_sentences.text: Recent work has introduced structural fidelity as a tabular-specific evaluation dimension to assess whether synthetic data complies with the causal structures of real data.

evidence.anchor: structural fidelity as a tabular-specific evaluation dimension

abstract_sentences.handoff: moves from general evaluation to structure

abstract_sentences.text: However, existing benchmarks often neglect the interplay between structural fidelity and conventional evaluation dimensions, thus failing to provide a holistic understanding of model performance.

evidence.anchor: neglect the interplay between structural fidelity and conventional evaluation dimensions

abstract_sentences.text: Moreover, they are typically limited to toy datasets, as quantifying existing structural fidelity metrics requires access to ground-truth causal structures, which are rarely available for real-world datasets.

evidence.anchor: ground-truth causal structures, which are rarely available

abstract_sentences.handoff: states why existing structural metrics do not scale to real data

abstract_sentences.text: In this paper, we propose a novel evaluation framework that jointly considers structural fidelity and conventional evaluation dimensions.

evidence.anchor: jointly considers structural fidelity and conventional evaluation dimensions

abstract_sentences.text: We introduce a new evaluation metric, global utility, which enables the assessment of structural fidelity even in the absence of ground-truth causal structures.

evidence.anchor: global utility in the absence of ground-truth causal structures

abstract_sentences.text: In addition, we present TabStruct, a comprehensive evaluation benchmark offering large-scale quantitative analysis on 13 tabular generators from nine distinct categories, across 29 datasets.

evidence.anchor: 13 tabular generators from nine distinct categories, across 29 datasets

abstract_sentences.handoff: turns the metric into a benchmark

abstract_sentences.text: Our results demonstrate that global utility provides a task-independent, domain-agnostic lens for tabular generator performance.

evidence.anchor: task-independent, domain-agnostic lens

abstract_sentences.text: We release the TabStruct benchmark suite, including all datasets, evaluation pipelines, and raw results.

evidence.anchor: including all datasets, evaluation pipelines, and raw results
Code is available at github.com/SilenceX12138/TabStruct

abstract_sentences.handoff: closes with an executable entry point

experimental_design.name: Core SCM datasets

evidence.anchor: six expert-validated SCM datasets with 7-64 features
references to “six SCM datasets”

experimental_design.name: Large SCM extension
experimental_design.description: Five additional large SCM datasets (ANDES, Diabetes, Link, Pathfinder, PIGS) are used in Appendix E.2; Appendix D lists 11 SCM datasets in all.

evidence.anchor: five classification datasets with large SCMs

experimental_design.name: Real-world datasets
experimental_design.description: Fourteen classification and nine regression datasets from TabZilla/OpenML/UCI; 23 total, with the ranges stated in Section 4.

evidence.anchor: 23 challenging real-world datasets
Details of 14 real-world classification datasets

experimental_design.name: Generator coverage
experimental_design.description: Thirteen methods from nine categories are evaluated, with Dref included as a reference evaluator.

evidence.anchor: 13 existing tabular data generation methods of nine different categories

experimental_design.name: Nested repeated split
experimental_design.description: 80% train/20% test, then 90% training/10% validation inside train; stratification for classification; ten repeated shuffles; Nsyn=Nref.

evidence.anchor: 80% train and 20% test
repeat the splitting 10 times

experimental_design.name: Generator tuning
experimental_design.description: Optuna minimizes each generator’s own average validation loss across ten repeats; at most two hours per generator per repeat.

evidence.anchor: tune the parameterised generators using Optuna
tune each generator based on its own objective function

experimental_design.name: Downstream predictor ensemble
experimental_design.description: Full-tuned uses nine predictors; Light-tuned eight; Tiny-tuned and Tiny-default three; one hour per feature per repeat for full tuning and default TabPFN.

evidence.anchor: Full-tuned … nine predictors
one hour of tuning budget per repeat

experimental_design.name: Evaluation dimensions
experimental_design.description: Density (Shape, Trend, α-precision, β-recall), privacy (DCR, δ-Presence), ML efficacy (local utility), and structural fidelity (local/global CI and global utility).

evidence.anchor: four complementary evaluation dimensions

experimental_design.name: Preprocessing
experimental_design.description: Mean/mode imputation, training-derived one-hot or ordinal encoding, Z-score normalization, and inverse transform before downstream prediction.

evidence.anchor: compute each feature’s mean and standard deviation in the training data

experimental_design.name: Contamination control
experimental_design.description: Public datasets are selected as contamination-free; real-world datasets were not in TabPFN meta-validation; proprietary/undisclosed LLMs are excluded.

evidence.anchor: excludes models based on proprietary or undisclosed LLMs
reducing the likelihood that their causal structures were implicitly leaked

experimental_design.name: Random seeds and resources
experimental_design.description: Random seeds are fixed for data loading/evaluation; hardware is NVIDIA A100 80GB plus 64-core Xeon at 2.20GHz on Ubuntu 20.04.5 LTS.

evidence.anchor: fixed the random seeds for data loading and evaluation

experimental_design.description: Ten-repeat results are aggregated within SCM or real-world datasets using ADTM affine renormalization; tables report normalized mean ± std.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 传统 density/ML/privacy 指标可能把局部任务成功误当作 tabular authenticity；论文以 CPDAG-level CI 定义结构，再提出逐变量 normalized prediction 的 global utility，最后用 6 core SCM + 23 real-world、13 generators 的 Q1–Q4 验证相关、排序、稳健性和成本。[p.2–10，§1–4，anchor: “global utility provides a task-independent, domain-agnostic lens”，basis=interpretation]
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 Figure 1 物理-law 反例、SCM/CPDAG/CI 定义、Eq.1–4、local/global distinction、四个 RQ、Table 2、Figure 3–4、diffusion/GReaT 机制及 empirical-proof limitation，足以做 structural dimension 和 metric selection 的决策。[p.2、p.5–10，§3–5，anchor: “The strong correlation and consistent generator ranking”，basis=interpretation]
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Algorithm 1/2、CI implementation、dataset rows、generator hyperparameters、split/preprocessing、predictor tuning、ADTM、large-SCM/latent-confounder/causal-inference/independent-set checks 和 Tables 38–66 均在附录；正文 headline 可读，但完整复现和异质性检查依赖 B/D/E/F。[p.7–10、p.25–63，§4/Appendix，anchor: “Full implementation details are available in Appendix D”，basis=interpretation]
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 1 把 physical system→causal graph→CI→metric failure 放在同一视觉因果链；Table 2 横向并置四维指标；Figure 3/4 分别把互补性和实用性转为 rank/efficiency 证据。[p.2、p.8–10，Figures 1/3/4/Table 2，anchor: “conventional metrics are insufficient”，basis=interpretation]
final_judgment.largest_gap: global utility 只被证明与 global CI 经验相关，依赖“用其余变量预测每个变量”的 heuristic；没有 real-world GT SCM、formal proof、完整 causal identification，也未完全拆开 predictor/model/data heterogeneity。[p.8、p.10、p.29、p.48，§4.2/4.4/C.2/E.6，anchor: “ground-truth causal structures are rarely available”，basis=explicit]
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 结构保真评估应先定义跨变量 observable surrogate，再在 known/expert structure 校准集上检查 metric values、induced rankings、失败案例和外部机制任务；同时保留 target-local decomposition，避免单一 downstream task 代替全局结构。[p.5–6、p.38–47，§3/E，anchor: “global utility provides similar generator rankings as global CI”，basis=interpretation]
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 规则要求可验证结构校准集和稳定 downstream protocol；不能把 global utility 当作真实 causal graph，也不能直接覆盖 latent confounding 全部情形、动态数据或不同 split policy 的部署表现。[p.29、p.44–48，C.2/E.4/E.6，anchor: “extend … to temporal and event-based data”，basis=explicit]

reading_notes.physical_reading: PDF pages 1–63 read, including references, Appendix A–F, all figures/tables/algorithms.
reading_notes.layout: Main body is two-column; Figure 1/2 and Table 2 are wide; table-heavy Appendix F occupies pages 49–63.
reading_notes.statistical_boundary: No multiple-comparison correction, bootstrap, Bayesian analysis, regression, or interval estimates are reported; Spearman correlations, p-values, and mean ± std are the visible statistical summaries.
reading_notes.ablation_boundary: No conventional named component-ablation section; Appendix E contains controlled variants and sensitivity analyses captured in ablation_inventory.
reading_notes.lexical_notes: Core terms are structural fidelity, global utility, local utility, global/local CI, SCM, tabular generators, downstream predictors, and permutation-invariant diffusion; hyphenated/Greek terms and repeated table tokens are error-prone for automatic counts.
